name: (02) Setite Sorcery (The Immanence of Set) — 2 Intermediate — Tongue of the Tempter

system.description:
All Setites are chosen for their gift at manipulating mortal and Cainite minds alike, but this power sharpens that gift to a hypnotic edge capable of loosening the tightest lips and drawing out a victim's most secret desires.

System: The Setite must invoke this power immediately after sundown, spending two Blood Traits and winning a Social challenge against the target's Willpower. She must then seek out the victim and hold him in conversation for at least half an hour; on success he lets slip one of his secret fears or desires without ever realizing he has done so, the importance of the revelation left to the Storyteller's discretion.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
